Daniel|So walk me through the onboarding screen, from the top.
Samantha|Sure. You start on customer search, put in the postcode and surname, then hit search.
Fred|And what if they already have an account with us?
Samantha|Then it lists the existing matches so you don't create a duplicate record.
Daniel|Got it. And who can approve a new record?
Samantha|Only team leads can approve, the button doesn't show for anyone else.
